title: junellia bisulcata var. campestris
intro: Junellia bisulcata var. campestris, commonly known as "Ragone", is a plant species that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions. The health benefits of Junellia bisulcata var. campestris include wound healing, protection against oxidative stress, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
